entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello? I need to start a return for some shoes I bought.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your order number to start?

Thank you. I see the order for the Mountain Bike cycling shoes delivered on November 15th. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's more about the fit. I've taken them out a few times, and no matter how I position the cleats, I keep getting painful blisters on my heels. They just don't work for my feet.

I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key. Let me just check the return policy for you... Okay, I see here that you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh, great. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'll be sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. Just pack the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, we will process your full refund.

That's fantastic, thank you Charlie. I appreciate how easy that was. Since I'll need to buy another pair, and this has been a bit of an inconvenience, is there any possibility of getting a small discount code for my next VeloFit purchase?

That's a reasonable question. While I can't provide a discount code as part of the return process, I can assure you the full refund will be processed promptly. We do have a holiday sale starting next week, so I'd recommend keeping an eye on the website for new deals.
Okay, that's fair. I'll watch for the sale. Thanks again for your help with the refund.
You're very welcome. The email with the return label should be in your inbox shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
